description: This PHP class defines a console command 'ResetDatabaseCommand' within a testing framework for the OrangeHRM system. The command resets the database to its initial state during functional testing, utilizing the DatabaseBackupService to restore the savepoint and providing user feedback via console output.

classes.name: ResetDatabaseCommand
classes.description: A console command class for resetting the database to its initial state during testing.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the console command.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command to restore the database to its initial savepoint.
